item_selection: oldest last_verified first; exclude unresolved PENDING proposals
source_priority: reputable local media only when primary sources are unavailable
rules: Always show source name, publication or reference date, and original URL.
For laws, tax, licenses, registrations, and official statistics, do not update from media-only evidence when an official source should exist.
Preserve the wording style, unit, date notation, and compactness of the existing OCIS value when proposing a replacement.
Do not overwrite current OCIS values automatically; store proposals separately.
If newer authoritative evidence is not found, mark KEEP or REVIEW rather than forcing an update.
Keep retrieved evidence concise to minimize LLM token use; normally use no more than two sources per item.
